episode.title: A Broken Promise
goal: I can apologise for a missed plan and explain what I will change.
約束を守れなかったことを謝り、改善することを伝えられる。
intro: Emma works an extra Thursday in Osaka. Leo makes her favorite dinner at Kamo House. Emma goes to a work gathering and forgets to tell him. She calls late. Leo is disappointed. Claire finds him alone after the food is cold.
エマは木曜日も追加で大阪勤務です。レオは約束どおりKamo Houseで好物の夕食を作ります。エマは職場の集まりに行き、連絡を忘れます。電話したときには遅く、レオは失望しています。料理が冷めた後、クレアは一人のレオを見つけます。
episode.warmup: What can you say in this situation?
words: 夕食の約束を守れませんでした。
電話するのを忘れました。
私を待ってくれていました。
I will call before plans change.
予定が変わる前に電話します。
discussion: II. Use two of the new expressions to talk about this situation.
この場面について、新しい表現を二つ使って話しましょう。
episode.followup: What question can you ask next?

rule: Use the past form to say what happened.
過去形で、起きたことを伝えます。
Use did not + verb to say what did not happen.
did not ＋動詞で、しなかったことを伝えます。

situation: Emma calls Leo after missing their Thursday dinner. Read their conversation.
木曜日の夕食の約束を守れなかったエマが、レオに電話します。会話を読みましょう。
dialogue: Emma, I made dinner and waited.
I am sorry. I went to a work gathering.
We had a plan. It is not just the food.
I know. You worked hard for me.
I do not want another dinner plan tonight.
I understand. We can talk later.
Please call before changing our plans.
I will. I am sorry I left you waiting.
questions: Emma missed dinner and did not call.
Does Leo want another dinner plan now?

choices: Emma missed dinner and did not call.
Does Leo want another dinner plan now?

situation: You are Emma, calling Leo after missing Thursday's dinner. Your tutor is Leo. He cooked for you and waited without an update. You attended a work gathering instead and did not contact him.
あなたは木曜日の夕食の約束を守れず、レオに電話しているエマ役です。講師はレオ役です。レオは料理を作り、連絡のないまま待っていました。あなたは仕事後の集まりに参加し、連絡しませんでした。
task: Explain what happened. Thank Leo for his effort. Apologise, offer a clear change, and accept that he needs time.
起きたことを説明しましょう。レオの努力に感謝し、謝り、具体的な改善を伝えましょう。時間が必要だという気持ちを受け止めましょう。
lines: Where were you? We had a dinner plan.
I cooked and waited. Why did you not call?
What will you do when a plan changes?
I need time. Can we talk another day?
mission.evidence: Admit gathering and missed call, acknowledge waiting/preparation, should have called, specific advance-update plan, accept later conversation. Leo need not forgive or arrange another date during the task. Assess communication rather than a forced reconciliation.

trivia: “Sorry to keep you waiting” is an apology for a delay. Naming the problem makes the apology clearer.
Sorry to keep you waiting は、待たせたことを謝る表現です。何について謝っているかを伝えると分かりやすくなります。
triviaQuestion: Is this an apology for making someone wait?
episode.closing: Claire listens to Leo without trying to solve everything for him. The next evening, Emma makes another choice that she will regret.
